model_annotation: This bar chart compares the sensitivity of 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit across various block indexes. The horizontal axis represents the block index, labeled from 0 to 47, while the vertical axis represents sensitivity on a logarithmic scale from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-4}$. The 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit are represented by green and blue bars, respectively. Each set of bars is grouped by block index, with the green bar for 2-Fbit on the left and the blue bar for 4-Fbit on the right at each index. At block index 0, the 2-Fbit has a sensitivity of around $10^{-5}$, while 4-Fbit is not visible. For block index 47, the 4-Fbit has a sensitivity around $10^{-4}$ and the 2-Fbit around $9 \cdot 10^{-5}$. The remaining block indexes show a gradual increase in sensitivity for both 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit, with 4-Fbit consistently higher than 2-Fbit, except at index 0.
